effects.description: Next step, in your own Brainstem, not Hive Hub: ask its Hive agent (agents/hive_agent.py) to join with exactly address https://contoso.invalid/hives/contoso-onboarding.git and id f934db89e0c73d71843d634b8ddbd53154732735 (the pinned root commit), plus your own name and device. It proposes first and acts only after your yes in a later turn: it copies the shared copy, checks every commit from that root, pins the root and the Hive id, and files one SSH-signed request file (request: rapp-hive) at requests/<name>/<device>.md. It must report Hive id 185d0eb5d4b1247b260042d0d840d5c3 and founder key SHA256:q18VTrWDieC+Sc25wpbcIHm4/gUotkmUJpyFgDeOdyY; if either differs, stop. Members admit you by moving that file into members/<name>/keys/. Hive Hub runs none of this and never writes into the Hive. The reviewed public copy is https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-model-hive/tree/2bd7c95152ede719b6418b80e2bdc2cd457bf711/example/contoso-onboarding-public; check it with check-public.
